blockingFindings.summary: The deterministic claims gate invents a minimum claim count and fails a legitimate empty result.
blockingFindings.evidence: tools/validate_factcheck.py:93 in load_claims asserts _require(claims, 'claims list is empty; at least one claim is required'). A draft with no externally verifiable facts yields a valid {"draft_path": ..., "claims": []} (the claims.schema.json claims array has no minItems), but both io.validate_claims and io.validate_verification call load_claims and therefore fail on empty claims. This turns a legitimate zero-result into a hard failure and blocks the empty-content coverage dimension. Repair: drop the non-empty assertion in load_claims so an empty claim list flows to a report that states no verifiable claims were found; keep the id, uniqueness and identity checks.
